full_judgment: 16. Abdus Sattar and others preferred Civil Petition No.2323 of 2009 to this Division but the same was dismissed on 03.02.2010 as being barred by limitation. A contempt petition was filed by the official Mutwalli against Deputy Commissioner, Gaibandha for not obeying the order of the High Court Division. Rule was issued and this Division stayed the order passed by the High Court Division.
